no_adcom_quote.quote: This application was not referred to an ODAC because the application showed improvement in overall survival and did not raise significant safety or efficacy issues.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for Xofigo (radium-223 dichloride, NDA 203971). The Office Director memo states the application was not referred to an ODAC because it showed improvement in overall survival and did not raise significant safety or efficacy issues; the Cross-Discipline Team Leader review and Medical Review likewise state the application was not discussed at an Advisory Committee meeting and that such a meeting was considered unnecessary. Because no AdComm occurred, there were no committee-driven changes to the approval.
